*At some point you regain consciousness and feel as though you're moving but the bag over your head prevents you from seeing and for some reason you can't seem to move at all as you continue to struggle with the situation you realize you're probably in a vehicle being taken somewhere*

*Suddenly the vehicle stops and you're lifted up onto your feet but still blindfolded but you can kind of feel your ability to move slowly regaining, as you realize that you get pushed down what feels like a slide. After what feels like an eternity of sliding your feet are suddenly met with floor as you tumble out.*

*And then a sort of sniffing noise emanating from the dark can be heard before suddenly the noises stops as something lets out a distorted and broken sounding* “HeLp…”
